title: Is multiplicative-exponential linear logic decidable?
formal: Is there an algorithm deciding provability of every propositional sequent of multiplicative-exponential linear logic, with its standard linear-logic contraction and weakening rules on exponentials?
context:
MELL excludes the additive connectives. Published decidability claims have been disputed; the cited 2025 branching-VASS paper still describes the general problem as open.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: A basic decidability boundary linking proof theory to branching vector addition systems.
